name: scope:trivial is a compat alias for xs
scope tag is case-insensitive among other tags
unrecognized scope value still scores statically
scope value is trimmed (NBSP + BOM + ideographic)
scope value trim uses the JS whitespace class (VT/FF/ogham)
scope prefix must be at index 0
scope: with only whitespace after it falls through
dotted capital I lowercases to i+combining-dot, NOT i (TINY)
dotted capital I lowercases to i+combining-dot, NOT i (MEDIUM)
scope-like tag without colon is ignored
later scope tag used when the first is unrecognized
empty description, explicit undefined fan-in -> m
empty description, fanIn 1 -> real signal, scores 0 points
a short real description scores below the no-signal default
longer description + few criteria + one file lands at m
